name: ratnapura-ditwah-rain-only
title: Ratnapura, Ditwah rainfall and soil saturation (landslide conditions)
story: The same storm seen only through ERA5 rainfall and soil saturation: what a landslide early warning would have had to go on, with no river gauge.
assumptions: River level converted from metres to the Sentinel's tabletop centimetres at 0.20 m per cm (the scale in data/reference/sensor_map.yaml).
Rainfall and soil moisture are ERA5 reanalysis (about 11-25 km cells), not gauge readings; soil moisture is scaled to percent of an assumed 0.5 m3/m3 saturation.
Time compressed 240x: the Sentinel's five-minute window and rate-of-rise threshold are measured in replay time.
